material.acceptance_criteria: a CI run serves a deliberately broken main.js and checks the page stays on its previous version with one client_error line and no reload.
material.description: The page reloads itself on any script change, so a broken edit reloads into a broken page. Validate the new script before reloading, keep the running page on failure, and log the failure.
material.resolution: Witnessed green on the tip by a separate witness session; caveat: runtime throws still reload.
material.subject: Reject a broken page edit instead of reloading into it
material.witness: Witness verdict GREEN at 7db475cd605b81f6a0b73b9bc327b7050b5048da (session gm-oscraft-sc2-alt-1-v51a): job 'a broken main.js edit leaves the served page running with one client_error line, and a good edit reloads it' conclusion success (ci run 38933111249 job 117081773077). Compile check main.js:356-365 uses new AsyncFunction (parse only), reload gated at main.js:376-380, one page-edit-rejected client_error line deduped per stamp at main.js:382-385; CI assert ci.yml:2386/2406/2417 matches the printed message prefix 'page edit rejected: '. Caveat: runtime throws still reload (compile-only check).
